system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Rather than treating model context as a static concatenation of the system prompt and complete interaction history, openJiuwen processes available information according to current context pressure, task state, and content structure.
system_prompt_style.note: No prompt-building code in evidence; inferred from paper prose on context construction.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Can call tools (files, shell, web search, etc.)
env_context_strategy.note: Paper also mentions LSP active queries (definition/reference lookup) requested by the agent.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Concrete mechanisms include dialogue summarization, incremental compression of large interaction histories, and full-session compaction.
context_compaction.note: Paper also describes structure-aware reduction of logs/diffs and offloading of large artifacts; code not in evidence.

observation_format.note: Tool-result conversion code not in evidence; browser service shipped. Screenshots inferred weakly.

tool_call_format.note: Paper says 'executes requested tool calls' without describing call syntax.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: External tool integration and Model Context Protocol configuration.
tool_schema_source.note: Only MCP source evidenced; built-in tool schema source not shown.

protocol_standardization.note: other = E2A (Gateway-AgentServer envelope protocol) and A2UI; E2A is project-internal.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Inner Loop follows a bounded ReAct-style interaction.
loop_primitives.note: Default react; Rails on lifecycle hooks (event_driven); Goal Mode continuation with assessment; Swarm Flow parallel candidates + review and deterministic multi-stage workflows reachable.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: 任务拆解、规划与执行管理，支持 TodoToolkit 工具进行任务跟踪。

multi_agent_topology.note: Cluster mode: Leader orchestrating specialized agents is default; Agent mode single agent selectable; Swarmflow pipeline reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Leader decomposes a complex task and assembles teams, multi agents specialize and negotiate dynamically.
delegation_mechanism.note: Swarmflow Leader hand-off between stage agents (role_handoff) also reachable.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: By default, tools ask for approval before they run. If you would rather not confirm every step, adjust the policy
human_in_loop.note: Default on_permission; Swarmflow human() HITL reachable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The workspace contains runtime data such as todos, sessions, and file storage.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Long-term across sessions; preferences and history
long_term_memory.note: Skill Hub/self-evolving skills; Task Memory experience retrieval (Self-Reflection) as episodic store. Storage format not in evidence.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Session information management, viewing and restoring historical chats, and deleting session history.

self_verification.evidence_quote: openJiuwen supports self-assessment, independent assessment, and hybrid assessment strategies.
self_verification.note: LSP diagnostics auto-injected after code changes (Sec. 3.2.4); Goal Mode defaults unknown.

retry_policy.note: Paper mentions 'bounded retry or recovery' at Outer Loop and max attempts in Goal Mode; default unclear.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The interaction continues until the model returns an answer, execution is interrupted, or the configured step limit is reached.
termination_condition.note: Team token budget in Swarmflow per README; Goal Mode hard limits on attempts/time.

cost_controls.note: Caching from paper: KV-cache reuse via session affinity.

timeouts.evidence_quote: """Resolve the per-round timeout; an omitted/null value means no limit."""
timeouts.note: Per-round completion_timeout, off by default (null). Per-tool timeouts not evidenced.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: 管理本地 jiuwenbox uvicorn 子进程 — 由 ``/sandbox enable`` 触发启动.
execution_isolation.note: Sandbox (jiuwenbox) is opt-in via /sandbox enable; default runs on host.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: file access goes through a whitelist

permission_model.evidence_quote: tools require approval before execution, file access goes through a whitelist, and sensitive operations are intercepted

tracing.evidence_quote: System log paths, runtime records, and common troubleshooting entry points.

eval_hooks.note: Paper evaluates on SWE-bench Verified; runner location not evidenced.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Security interception and permission control for system commands, file operations, and tool calls.

target_domain.evidence_quote: **Work**, for office, collaboration, and general tasks, and **Code**, for viewing and modifying code in a project directory
